note: A recomputation layer over the sealed records, concentrated on the campaigns added since the manuscript was first sealed, rather than an exhaustive inventory of the manuscript's numbers, whose coverage is the claim map. Each entry names the sealed record it derives from, the derivation, the value pinned when it was last confirmed, and where it is printed. claims_ledger.py recomputes all three. A claim whose source digest has moved is reported stale rather than passed.
